findings.title: intent clarify leaves partial workspace on failure
findings.message: The workspace directory is created first, and the artifact writes follow. If any later step fails (disk error, atomic write error, or the recorded-provider resume), a half-populated workspace remains. A retry with the same --output then fails at os.Mkdir because the directory already exists, and the user has to delete it by hand. This contradicts the 'no answer workspace written' cancellation semantics.
findings.suggestion: Build the answer workspace in a temp directory next to the output and rename it into place once all files are written. Alternatively, remove the directory on error.

findings.title: Filtered environment can fall back to inheriting all secrets
findings.message: cmd.Env starts as nil and is only filled by appending the entries that pass the filter. If every environment entry is filtered out, or the environment is empty, cmd.Env stays nil. os/exec treats nil as 'inherit the full parent environment', so credential variables would reach kicad-cli, which defeats the stated purpose of this runner. The case is rare but it fails open.
findings.suggestion: Initialize cmd.Env to a non-nil empty slice before the loop so the filtered environment is always used, even when it is empty.
